title: Resolve the non-Markovian CQ-gravity escape
research_target: Determine whether a specified correlated or non-Markovian Gaussian classical-quantum gravity kernel can preserve complete positivity, finite vacuum excitation and a finite GR-normalized radiative response. The pointwise additive decoherence floor is an extra assumption, not general CP; keep scalar and spin-2 channels separate and state the light-cone distribution/counterterm prescription. Do not reinstate the withdrawn 32-orders exclusion or call the preferred-frame smearing interval an allowed window. Work one explicit kernel through the retarded response and noise integrals, including finite-bandwidth sources, or prove a scoped obstruction with every added hypothesis exposed. Reconcile current attempts and avoid relitigating the already-bounded additive scalar result.
